What you click becomes a name in this document, and every brick</span><span class="dl a">+below reads that name.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=c1</span><span class="dl a">+organelle = {&#x27;name&#x27;: &#x27;nothing yet&#x27;, &#x27;doc&#x27;: &#x27;Click an organelle above.&#x27;}</span><span class="dl a">+seen = []</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=c2 src=leela_bricks:learn.cell emit_organelle=organelle</span><span class="dl a">+bind label = organelle[&#x27;name&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 420</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=c3</span><span class="dl a">+if organelle[&#x27;name&#x27;] not in seen and organelle[&#x27;name&#x27;] != &#x27;nothing yet&#x27;: seen = seen + [organelle[&#x27;name&#x27;]]</span><span class="dl a">+found = len(seen)</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=c4</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;### {organelle[&#x27;name&#x27;]}\n\n{organelle[&#x27;doc&#x27;]}\n\nYou have opened **{found} of 8**: {&#x27;, &#x27;.join(seen) or &#x27;none yet&#x27;}.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+## What the membranes are for</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+A cell keeps compartments because some reactions fight each other. A lysosome holds acid, and</span><span class="dl a">+the cytosol does not. A mitochondrion holds a proton gradient, and only a sealed membrane keeps</span><span class="dl a">+that gradient. The nucleus keeps transcription apart from translation. The cell therefore edits a</span><span class="dl a">+transcript before it reads it. Every membrane in the picture bounds one reaction.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas ask id=c5</span><span class="dl a">+explain mitochondrion</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--canvas quiz id=c6--&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+1. Why does messenger RNA exist at all</span><span class="dl a">+2. What would happen to a cell whose lysosomes leaked</span><span class="dl a">+3. Which organelle carries its own genome, and what does that suggest</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--/canvas--&gt;</span></div></div></div></details><figure><div class="diff"><div class="hd"><span class="p">examples/canvas/assets/brick-ports.pdf</span><span class="chip add">+0</span><span class="chip rm">-0</span></div><div class="body"><span class="dl ">Binary files /dev/null and b/examples/canvas/assets/brick-ports.pdf differ</span></div></div></figure><details><summary>examples/canvas/making-a-block.canvas.md +79 -0</summary><div class="in"><div class="diff"><div class="body"><span class="dl h">@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+title: Making a block</span><span class="dl a">+mode: make</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+# Making a block</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+This document holds the software and the note about it. The code below is what a library puts in</span><span class="dl a">+its own `data.py`, and the component under it reads that data. Both of them run here.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=m1</span><span class="dl a">+from datetime import date, timedelta</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+def burndown(start, days, done_per_day):</span><span class="dl a">+ &quot;Points left on each day, from a start and a rate.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ left, out = start, []</span><span class="dl a">+ for i in range(days):</span><span class="dl a">+ left = max(0, left - done_per_day)</span><span class="dl a">+ out.append({&#x27;day&#x27;: (date(2026, 9, 1) + timedelta(days=i)).strftime(&#x27;%d %b&#x27;), &#x27;left&#x27;: left})</span><span class="dl a">+ return out</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+plan = burndown(180, 12, 16)</span><span class="dl a">+labels = [p[&#x27;day&#x27;] for p in plan]</span><span class="dl a">+left = [p[&#x27;left&#x27;] for p in plan]</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=m2 src=leela_bricks:viz.series emit_point=point</span><span class="dl a">+bind labels = labels</span><span class="dl a">+bind series = [{&#x27;name&#x27;: &#x27;points left&#x27;, &#x27;values&#x27;: left}]</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 240</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=m3</span><span class="dl a">+point = {&#x27;label&#x27;: labels[0], &#x27;value&#x27;: left[0]}</span><span class="dl a">+lands = next((p[&#x27;day&#x27;] for p in plan if p[&#x27;left&#x27;] == 0), &#x27;not in this window&#x27;)</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=m4</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;On the plan as written it lands **{lands}**. You clicked {point[&#x27;label&#x27;]}, where {point[&#x27;value&#x27;]} points were left.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--canvas note id=m5--&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+The brick above is `leela_bricks:viz.series`. The palette inserted it with `/`, and its own</span><span class="dl a">+package supplied the two lines that fill it. The block menu on the gutter grip opens the wiring</span><span class="dl a">+panel, which shows the expressions you would have written by hand.</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--/canvas--&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+## Sketching a component before it is a package</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+A sketch is a component this file itself defines. It gets the same two messages a packaged brick</span><span class="dl a">+gets, and nothing more. You can move a sketch into a package without changing a line of it.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas sim id=m6</span><span class="dl a">+bind done = done</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 190</span><span class="dl a">+const draw = () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl a">+ const done = props.done ?? 0.4;</span><span class="dl a">+ root.innerHTML = `&lt;svg viewBox=&quot;0 0 400 120&quot; style=&quot;width:100%&quot;&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;rect x=&quot;10&quot; y=&quot;40&quot; width=&quot;380&quot; height=&quot;26&quot; rx=&quot;13&quot; fill=&quot;#e7ebf3&quot;&gt;&lt;/rect&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;rect x=&quot;10&quot; y=&quot;40&quot; width=&quot;${(380*done).toFixed(0)}&quot; height=&quot;26&quot; rx=&quot;13&quot; fill=&quot;#2f6df6&quot;&gt;&lt;/rect&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;text x=&quot;200&quot; y=&quot;90&quot; text-anchor=&quot;middle&quot; font-size=&quot;13&quot; fill=&quot;#6b7280&quot;&gt;${(done*100).toFixed(0)}% of the plan burned down&lt;/text&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;/svg&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;div class=&quot;row&quot;&gt;&lt;input type=range min=0 max=1 step=0.01 id=d value=&quot;${done}&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;`;</span><span class="dl a">+ root.querySelector(&#x27;#d&#x27;).oninput = e =&gt; { emit(&#x27;done&#x27;, +e.target.value); };</span><span class="dl a">+};</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=m7</span><span class="dl a">+done = 1 - left[-1]/180</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas pdf id=m9 src=assets/brick-ports.pdf</span><span class="dl a">+The contract a component makes with a document, on one page. It is a file beside this one, and</span><span class="dl a">+`/canvas/file` will not serve anything outside the canvas directory.</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas ask id=m8</span><span class="dl a">+what is a bind?</span><span class="dl a">+```</span></div></div></div></details><details><summary>examples/canvas/pricing-a-run.canvas.md +69 -0</summary><div class="in"><div class="diff"><div class="body"><span class="dl h">@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+title: Pricing a run</span><span class="dl a">+mode: make</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+# Pricing a run</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+An agent run costs four numbers and one multiplication. Every argument about the cost is an</span><span class="dl a">+argument about one of the four. Put the four in a cell, and the argument becomes editable.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=p1</span><span class="dl a">+in_tokens = 18_000</span><span class="dl a">+out_tokens = 2_400</span><span class="dl a">+runs_a_day = 400</span><span class="dl a">+prices = {&#x27;Opus 5&#x27;: (15, 75), &#x27;Sonnet 5&#x27;: (3, 15), &#x27;Haiku 4.5&#x27;: (0.8, 4)}</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=p2</span><span class="dl a">+def cost(model):</span><span class="dl a">+ i, o = prices[model]</span><span class="dl a">+ return in_tokens/1e6*i + out_tokens/1e6*o</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+rows = [{&#x27;label&#x27;: m, &#x27;per_request&#x27;: round(cost(m), 5), &#x27;monthly&#x27;: round(cost(m)*runs_a_day*30, 2)}</span><span class="dl a">+ for m in prices]</span><span class="dl a">+rows</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=p3 src=leela_bricks:thrifty.costs emit_row=picked</span><span class="dl a">+bind rows = rows</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 220</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=p4</span><span class="dl a">+picked = rows[-1]</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=p5</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;**{picked[&#x27;label&#x27;]}** at this shape of request is ${picked[&#x27;per_request&#x27;]} a call and ${picked[&#x27;monthly&#x27;]:,.0f} a month at {runs_a_day} runs a day. The cheapest option is {(min(rows, key=lambda r: r[&#x27;monthly&#x27;])[&#x27;monthly&#x27;]/picked[&#x27;monthly&#x27;]*100):.0f}% of that.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+Click a row. `picked` changes, and the sentence below binds to `picked`, which changes it too.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+## The knob that actually matters</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas sim id=p6</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 120</span><span class="dl a">+const draw = () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl a">+ root.innerHTML = `&lt;div class=&quot;row&quot;&gt;&lt;label style=&quot;width:140px&quot;&gt;runs a day&lt;/label&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;input type=range min=50 max=5000 step=50 id=r&gt;&lt;b id=v&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/div&gt;`;</span><span class="dl a">+ const r = root.querySelector(&#x27;#r&#x27;);</span><span class="dl a">+ r.value = props.runs_a_day ?? 400;</span><span class="dl a">+ const show = () =&gt; root.querySelector(&#x27;#v&#x27;).textContent = r.value;</span><span class="dl a">+ r.oninput = show; r.onchange = () =&gt; { show(); emit(&#x27;runs_a_day&#x27;, +r.value); }; show();</span><span class="dl a">+};</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=p7 src=leela_bricks:viz.series</span><span class="dl a">+bind labels = [r[&#x27;label&#x27;] for r in rows]</span><span class="dl a">+bind series = [{&#x27;name&#x27;: &#x27;monthly $&#x27;, &#x27;values&#x27;: [r[&#x27;monthly&#x27;] for r in rows]}]</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 240</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+Every model here prices an output token at four to five times an input token. A longer prompt</span><span class="dl a">+therefore costs little, and a longer answer costs much more. This is why &quot;make it more concise&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+is a budget decision.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas ask id=p8</span><span class="dl a">+chart rows</span><span class="dl a">+```</span></div></div></div></details><details><summary>examples/canvas/the-traditional-day.canvas.md +67 -0</summary><div class="in"><div class="diff"><div class="body"><span class="dl h">@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+title: The traditional day</span><span class="dl a">+mode: learn</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+# The traditional day</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+A day in the panchangam runs sunrise to sunrise, not midnight to midnight. Five limbs read at</span><span class="dl a">+that sunrise give the day its name. The components below come from `leela_bricks`, and they</span><span class="dl a">+compute the limbs here rather than fetch them.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=td1</span><span class="dl a">+import json, urllib.request</span><span class="dl a">+_ports = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(&#x27;http://127.0.0.1:5001/bricks/data/panchanga.day&#x27;))</span><span class="dl a">+day = _ports[&#x27;day&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+day[&#x27;tithi&#x27;][&#x27;name&#x27;], day[&#x27;nakshatra&#x27;][&#x27;name&#x27;], day[&#x27;masa&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+This cell is the wiring `leela_bricks:panchanga.day` ships. With the package installed beside the</span><span class="dl a">+document, the wiring is two imports and a call. Without the package, as here, the same call goes</span><span class="dl a">+to the host that owns it. The document keeps whichever wiring it used, in the open.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=td2 src=leela_bricks:panchanga.day emit_limb=limb</span><span class="dl a">+bind day = day</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 250</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=td3</span><span class="dl a">+limb = &#x27;tithi&#x27;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=td4</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;You are looking at the **{limb}**: {day[limb][&#x27;name&#x27;]}, until {day[limb].get(&#x27;end&#x27;,&#x27;—&#x27;)[11:16]}.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+Click a limb above. The card hands the name back into this document, and the sentence follows it.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+## The twenty-four horas</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+The panchangam cuts each daylight and each night into twelve horas, and the lords run in the</span><span class="dl a">+Chaldean order. The lord of the weekday takes the first hora of the day. Almost every language</span><span class="dl a">+that names a weekday for a planet follows that rule.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=td5 src=leela_bricks:panchanga.horas emit_hora=hora</span><span class="dl a">+bind horas = day[&#x27;horas&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 150</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=td6</span><span class="dl a">+hora = day[&#x27;horas&#x27;][0]</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=td7</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;**{hora[&#x27;name&#x27;]}** hora, {hora[&#x27;start&#x27;][11:16]} to {hora[&#x27;end&#x27;][11:16]}, {hora[&#x27;phase&#x27;]}.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+## Where the grahas actually are</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=td8 src=leela_bricks:panchanga.wheel emit_rasi=rasi</span><span class="dl a">+bind planets = day[&#x27;planets&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+bind highlight = day[&#x27;moon_rasi&#x27;]</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 380</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas ask id=td9</span><span class="dl a">+explain nakshatra</span><span class="dl a">+```</span></div></div></div></details><details><summary>examples/canvas/tunnelling.canvas.md +69 -0</summary><div class="in"><div class="diff"><div class="body"><span class="dl h">@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+title: Tunnelling</span><span class="dl a">+mode: learn</span><span class="dl a">+---</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+# Tunnelling</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+A particle with less energy than a barrier still turns up on the other side. It goes through the</span><span class="dl a">+barrier rather than over the top. The amplitude inside the barrier decays instead of oscillating.</span><span class="dl a">+If the barrier ends before the decay finishes, the remaining amplitude keeps going.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+The simulation below integrates the one-dimensional Schrödinger equation in the frame, at forty</span><span class="dl a">+steps a screen refresh. It computes every frame as it draws.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=q1</span><span class="dl a">+barrier = 1.02</span><span class="dl a">+width = 6</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas brick id=q2 src=leela_bricks:learn.wavepacket emit_transmission=transmission</span><span class="dl a">+bind barrier = barrier</span><span class="dl a">+bind width = width</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 300</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas sim id=q3</span><span class="dl a">+prop height = 130</span><span class="dl a">+const draw = () =&gt; {</span><span class="dl a">+ root.innerHTML = `&lt;div class=&quot;row&quot;&gt;&lt;label style=&quot;width:130px&quot;&gt;barrier ×E&lt;/label&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;input type=range min=0.9 max=2 step=0.02 id=b&gt;&lt;b id=bv&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/div&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;div class=&quot;row&quot;&gt;&lt;label style=&quot;width:130px&quot;&gt;width&lt;/label&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+ &lt;input type=range min=2 max=30 step=1 id=w&gt;&lt;b id=wv&gt;&lt;/b&gt;&lt;/div&gt;`;</span><span class="dl a">+ const b = root.querySelector(&#x27;#b&#x27;), w = root.querySelector(&#x27;#w&#x27;);</span><span class="dl a">+ b.value = props.barrier ?? 1.02; w.value = props.width ?? 6;</span><span class="dl a">+ const show = () =&gt; { root.querySelector(&#x27;#bv&#x27;).textContent = (+b.value).toFixed(2);</span><span class="dl a">+ root.querySelector(&#x27;#wv&#x27;).textContent = w.value; };</span><span class="dl a">+ b.onchange = () =&gt; { show(); emit(&#x27;barrier&#x27;, +b.value); };</span><span class="dl a">+ w.onchange = () =&gt; { show(); emit(&#x27;width&#x27;, +w.value); };</span><span class="dl a">+ b.oninput = show; w.oninput = show; show();</span><span class="dl a">+};</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas code id=q4</span><span class="dl a">+transmission = 0.0</span><span class="dl a">+kappa = round((2 * max(1e-6, (barrier - 1)) * 0.245) ** 0.5, 4)</span><span class="dl a">+predicted = round(2.718281828 ** (-2 * kappa * width) * 100, 2)</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas data id=q5</span><span class="dl a">+bind text = f&quot;At {barrier:.2f}× the packet energy over {width} cells, the decay constant κ is {kappa} and the crude estimate exp(−2κa) is **{predicted}%**. The simulation is measuring **{transmission*100:.1f}%**.&quot;</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+Drag the barrier up. The transmitted lobe on the right disappears long before the barrier reaches</span><span class="dl a">+twice the packet energy. Tunnelling falls exponentially with both the height and the width. A</span><span class="dl a">+barrier half again as thick therefore leaks much less than half as much.</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas ask id=q6</span><span class="dl a">+explain tunnelling</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+```canvas video id=q7 src=Ltni6c1lC4c</span><span class="dl a">+Sixty Symbols explains quantum tunnelling aloud.</span><span class="dl a">+```</span><span class="dl a">+</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--canvas quiz id=q8--&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+1. Why does doubling the barrier width cost more than doubling its height</span><span class="dl a">+2. What is the packet doing inside the barrier, if it is not oscillating</span><span class="dl a">+3. Where does the reflected part of the packet go</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;!--/canvas--&gt;</span></div></div></div></details><details><summary>media/canvas-branch.html +282 -0</summary><div a&quot;&gt;+ if not was: return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: False, &amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27;: &amp;#x27;nothing was selected&amp;#x27;}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ at = _find(b.body, was, int(op.get(&amp;#x27;nth&amp;#x27;) or 0))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if at is None: return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: False, &amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27;: &amp;#x27;that selection is no longer in this brick&amp;#x27;}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ i, n = at&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ b.body = b.body[:i] + now + b.body[i + n:]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ gone = runtime.retire(b) if runtime is not None else []&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: True, &amp;#x27;touched&amp;#x27;: [b.id], &amp;#x27;brick&amp;#x27;: b.dict(), &amp;#x27;dropped&amp;#x27;: gone}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _run(canvas, runtime, op):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ b = canvas.by_id(op.get(&amp;#x27;id&amp;#x27;))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b is None or not b.runs: return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: False, &amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27;: &amp;#x27;not a code brick&amp;#x27;}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ r = runtime.run(b)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ settle = runtime.react(canvas.bricks, r[&amp;#x27;defs&amp;#x27;], skip=[b.id])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: r[&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;], &amp;#x27;touched&amp;#x27;: [b.id], &amp;#x27;run&amp;#x27;: r, **settle}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _values(canvas, runtime, op):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: True, &amp;#x27;values&amp;#x27;: runtime.snapshot(op.get(&amp;#x27;names&amp;#x27;))}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _read(canvas, runtime, op): return {&amp;#x27;ok&amp;#x27;: True, &amp;#x27;canvas&amp;#x27;: canvas.dict()}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/details&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;card note&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;One function for every change, whether a person or the helper asked for it. &lt;code&gt;replace&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;kind&lt;/code&gt;,</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;code&gt;remove&lt;/code&gt; and &lt;code&gt;replace_selection&lt;/code&gt; now retire the names their brick defined. A renamed or deleted</span><span class="dl a">+definition cannot stay readable downstream.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;/div&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/procurement.canvas.md +190 -0&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;in&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;diff&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;body&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl h&quot;&gt;@@ -0,0 +1,190 @@&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+---&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+title: Procurement productivity +10%&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+default_exp: procure.core&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+---&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+# Increase procurement productivity by 10%&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas goal id=goal measure=&amp;quot;purchase orders per buyer FTE per month&amp;quot; baseline=&amp;quot;41 (FY25 actual)&amp;quot; target=45 by=2026-09-30--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Increase procurement productivity by 10% in FY26.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Indirect spend only. 62 buyers across 4 regions. Direct materials sit with the category teams and&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+are out of scope for this document.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k1 status=doing owner=Priya--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Agree the measure with Finance.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k2 status=doing owner=me--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Baseline the current cycle time.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k3 status=todo owner=me--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Ship the triage rule to one region.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## What we already know&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas source id=s-hackett title=&amp;quot;Hackett Group: procurement benchmark 2025&amp;quot; url=https://example.org/hackett-2025--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Top-quartile organisations process 2.3x the POs per buyer of the median. The gap is almost&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+entirely low-value tail spend that never needed a buyer.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas source id=s-audit title=&amp;quot;Internal audit, Q3 FY25&amp;quot; path=drive/audit-q3.pdf--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+34% of purchase orders raised in Q3 were under EUR 2,000. Median approval chain for those was 3&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+people and 6.2 days.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas source id=s-buyers title=&amp;quot;Buyer interviews (7)&amp;quot; context=keep--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Every buyer named the same two: re-keying supplier data from email, and chasing approvals that&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+nobody disputes.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas ask id=q-synth scope=region budget=12000&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Where does the 10% most plausibly come from? Use only the three sources here.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas reply of=q-synth--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Tail spend is the only pool big enough. 34% of POs are under EUR 2,000 and carry a three-person&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+approval chain that the audit found nobody ever rejects. Auto-approving that band would take&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+roughly a third of PO volume off the buyers without touching the categories where negotiation&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+earns money. On the interview evidence that is about 12% of buyer time, which clears the target.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## Baseline the tail&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-load&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+pos = read_extract(&amp;#x27;drive/po-q3.parquet&amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+preferred = frozenset(contracted_suppliers())&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-band&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+#|export&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def bands(pos, cut=2000):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Split a PO extract into the tail below `cut` and the rest.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ tail = pos[pos.value_eur &amp;lt; cut]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return tail, pos.drop(tail.index)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-share&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+tail, rest = bands(pos)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+share = len(tail) / len(pos)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+chain = tail.approvers.median()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+share, chain&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-cycle&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+cycle = tail.assign(days=(tail.approved_at - tail.raised_at).dt.days).groupby(&amp;#x27;region&amp;#x27;).days.mean()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+cycle&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas data id=d-say&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+bind text = f&amp;quot;The tail is **{share:.0%}** of all POs, sits behind **{chain:.0f}** approvers, and takes **{cycle.mean():.1f} days** to clear.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+The sentence above binds to the numbers rather than quoting them. Change the cut in `bands`, and it moves with everything else.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas ask id=q-fix scope=upstream budget=8000&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+`cycle_days` was not a column. Rebuild the cycle time from the timestamps and leave it as `cycle`.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## Prototype the triage rule&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas bundle id=triage title=&amp;quot;Auto-approve the contracted tail&amp;quot; goal=goal contributes=&amp;quot;most of the 10 points; the cap is the rest&amp;quot; paths=tests/test_triage.py refs=file:procure/core.py,pkg:pandas,doc:drive/audit-q3.pdf--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Adds `triage`, the rule that lets an indirect PO under EUR 2,000 from a contracted supplier skip&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+the approval chain. Backtested against the Q3 extract. The per-supplier cap is not in this change.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-rule&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+#|export&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def triage(po, cut=2000, trusted=frozenset()):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Whether a PO can skip the approval chain.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return po.value_eur &amp;lt; cut and po.supplier in trusted and po.contract_id is not None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas code id=c-backtest&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+auto = tail.apply(triage, axis=1, trusted=preferred)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+caught = auto.mean()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+caught&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas brick id=v-bars src=leela_bricks:viz.series emit_row=picked&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+bind labels = list(cycle.index)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+bind series = [{&amp;#x27;name&amp;#x27;: &amp;#x27;days to clear&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;values&amp;#x27;: list(cycle.values)}]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+prop height = 240&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas ask id=q-risk scope=upstream budget=10000 supports=s-audit&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+pin s-audit&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+What would have gone wrong if `triage` had run in Q3? `caught` says 79%. Check it against the audit.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas reply of=q-risk--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+79% of the tail clears the rule, which is 27% of all POs. Against the Q3 extract that is 14 POs&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+the audit flagged for split ordering, all from one supplier. Cap the rule per supplier per month&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+and those 14 stay in the chain.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k4 status=done owner=me--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Backtest the rule against Q3.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas note id=n-cap--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Nobody has built the cap yet, and a pilot needs it first.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## Decide&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas ask id=q-rec scope=doc budget=30000&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+pin goal&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+pin q-synth&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+pin q-risk&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+mute n-cap&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Draft the recommendation for the steering committee. One page, no hedging.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas reply of=q-rec--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Auto-approve indirect POs under EUR 2,000 from contracted suppliers, capped per supplier per&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+month. It removes 27% of PO volume from the approval chain, which the interview evidence puts at&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+about 12% of buyer time. Pilot one region for a quarter against the measure Finance agreed.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k5 status=blocked owner=Priya--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Steering committee slot. Waiting on the Finance sign-off in the first task.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Open: does the cap belong in the rule or in the ERP workflow?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## Cap the rule&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas goal id=cycle measure=&amp;quot;days from raised to approved, tail POs&amp;quot; baseline=6.2 target=2 by=2026-06-30--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Cut the approval cycle for tail POs to under 2 days.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas bundle id=cap title=&amp;quot;Cap the rule per supplier&amp;quot; goal=cycle contributes=&amp;quot;the audit finding, and the last of the 10 points&amp;quot; paths=procure/cap.py,tests/test_cap.py--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Limits how many auto-approved POs one supplier may raise in a month. The Q3 audit&amp;#x27;s&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+split-ordering finding needs that limit before a pilot.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k6 status=blocked owner=me--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Decide whether the cap lives in the rule or in the ERP workflow.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k7 status=todo owner=me--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Write the cap and its test.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```canvas ask id=q-cap scope=region budget=8000&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Where should the cap live, and what does each choice cost?&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+```&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+## Buyer dashboard&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas bundle id=dash title=&amp;quot;Buyer workload dashboard&amp;quot; paths=procure/dash.py--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+A weekly view of POs per buyer, which shows the measure without asking Finance for an extract.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--canvas task id=k8 status=doing owner=Priya--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Agree the weekly cut with Finance.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;!--/canvas--&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/details&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;card note&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;The demonstration document &lt;code&gt;example.py&lt;/code&gt; writes out. It carries a goal, three bundles, code bricks</span><span class="dl a">+with a dataflow, and an open question. Pins and `keep` never drop; `discard` goes first, then the oldest `auto`.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if not budget: return items&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ total = sum(i.chars + WRAP for i in items)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if total &amp;lt;= budget: return items&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ order = sorted((i for i, it in enumerate(items) if not it.pinned),&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ key=lambda i: (items[i].mode != &amp;#x27;discard&amp;#x27;, i))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ drop, n = set(), 0&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ while total &amp;gt; budget and n &amp;lt; len(order):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ total -= items[order[n]].chars + WRAP&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ drop.add(order[n])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ n += 1&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ kept = [it for i, it in enumerate(items) if i not in drop]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if sum(i.chars + WRAP for i in kept) &amp;gt; budget and kept:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ share = max(200, budget // max(1, len(kept)) - WRAP)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ kept = [replace(it, text=it.text[:share] + &amp;#x27;\n…&amp;#x27;, clipped=True) if it.chars &amp;gt; share else it&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for it in kept]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return kept&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def render(items, doc=None):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;The basket as `&amp;lt;cell&amp;gt;` markup, which is Leela’s own notebook context shape.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out = []&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for it in items:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if not it.text.strip(): continue&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ attr = (f&amp;#x27;id=&amp;quot;{it.ref}&amp;quot; type=&amp;quot;{it.kind}&amp;quot; compact=&amp;quot;{&amp;quot;keep&amp;quot; if it.pinned else &amp;quot;auto&amp;quot;}&amp;quot; &amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ f&amp;#x27;why=&amp;quot;{it.why}&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if it.region: attr += f&amp;#x27; region=&amp;quot;{it.region}&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if it.clipped: attr += &amp;#x27; clipped=&amp;quot;true&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out.append(f&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;cell {attr}&amp;gt;\n{it.text}\n&amp;lt;/cell&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if doc is not None and (links := _links(doc, {i.ref for i in items if i.text.strip()})):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out.append(&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;links&amp;gt;\n&amp;#x27; + &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(links) + &amp;#x27;\n&amp;lt;/links&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(out)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _links(doc, ids):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Relations the AST cannot see, for the pairs that both made it into the basket.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return [f&amp;#x27;{b.id} {rel} {other}&amp;#x27; for b in doc.bricks if b.id in ids&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for rel, targets in b.links.items() for other in targets if other in ids]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def weigh(items):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;What the panel prints above the basket: how many bricks, how many characters, what was cut.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;#x27;blocks&amp;#x27;: len(items), &amp;#x27;chars&amp;#x27;: sum(i.chars + WRAP for i in items),&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;#x27;pinned&amp;#x27;: sum(1 for i in items if i.pinned),&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;#x27;missing&amp;#x27;: [i.ref for i in items if i.kind == &amp;#x27;missing&amp;#x27;],&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;#x27;clipped&amp;#x27;: [i.ref for i in items if i.clipped and i.kind != &amp;#x27;missing&amp;#x27;]}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/details&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;card note&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;A question names its own scope, pins and budget. &lt;code&gt;resolve&lt;/code&gt; returns the exact bricks and the reason</span><span class="dl a">+each one is there. The budget sheds the least useful brick first, never a pin or the goal.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;/div&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/live.py +323 -0&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;in&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;diff&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;body&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl h&quot;&gt;@@ -0,0 +1,323 @@&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;quot;The live half: one namespace per canvas, cells that run, and bindings that recompute when their inputs move.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+from __future__ import annotations&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+import asyncio, io, json, math, threading, time, traceback&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+from dataclasses import is_dataclass, asdict&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+from .doc import downstream, order&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+__all__ = [&amp;#x27;Dataflow&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;Runtime&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;KernelRuntime&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;runtime_for&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;jsonable&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;stream&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;result&amp;#x27;,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;#x27;error_out&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;BOOT&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;TIMEOUT&amp;#x27;]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+#: What every canvas namespace starts with. A learning document should not open with an import cell.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+BOOT = &amp;quot;import math, random, json, statistics\nfrom datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\n&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+#: Seconds one cell may run before it is interrupted. A document is read on a phone, not batched.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+TIMEOUT = 30&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _records(v):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ to_dict = getattr(v, &amp;#x27;to_dict&amp;#x27;, None)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return to_dict(orient=&amp;#x27;records&amp;#x27;) if to_dict else None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def jsonable(v, depth=0):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;A value a brick can be drawn from: JSON where possible, a repr where not.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if v is None or isinstance(v, (bool, int, str)): return v&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if isinstance(v, float): return v if math.isfinite(v) else repr(v)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if depth &amp;gt; 6: return repr(v)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if isinstance(v, dict): return {str(k): jsonable(x, depth + 1) for k, x in v.items()}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if isinstance(v, (list, tuple, set)): return [jsonable(x, depth + 1) for x in v]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if is_dataclass(v) and not isinstance(v, type): return jsonable(asdict(v), depth + 1)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if hasattr(v, &amp;#x27;tolist&amp;#x27;): return jsonable(v.tolist(), depth + 1)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ rec = _records(v)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if rec is not None: return jsonable(rec, depth + 1)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return repr(v)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def stream(text, name=&amp;#x27;stdout&amp;#x27;): return dict(output_type=&amp;#x27;stream&amp;#x27;, name=name, text=text)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def result(v): return error_out(e):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ tb = traceback.format_exception(type(e), e, e.__traceback__)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return dict(output_type=&amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27;, ename=type(e).__name__, evalue=str(e), traceback=[l.rstrip() for l in tb[-4:]])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+def _err(name, msg): return dict(output_type=&amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27;, ename=name, evalue=msg, traceback=[f&amp;#x27;{name}: {msg}&amp;#x27;])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+class Dataflow:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;&amp;quot;&amp;quot;The dataflow half, which is the same wherever the code runs.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ A backend supplies four things: `exec_cell`, `eval_many`, `assign` and `names`. Nothing here&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ reaches into a namespace dict, so a document runs the same whether its code is in this process&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ or in a kernel.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;&amp;quot;&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def __init__(self):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ self.count = 0&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ #: What each brick defined the last time it ran. A name a brick stops defining is dropped,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ #: so a renamed or deleted cell cannot leave the old name readable to everything downstream.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ self.owned = {}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def run(self, brick):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Execute one code brick. Returns nbformat-shaped outputs and how long it took.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ t0 = time.perf_counter()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ outputs = self.exec_cell(brick.body or &amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;, brick.id)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ self.count += 1&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ self.retire(brick)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return dict(outputs=outputs, ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000, count=self.count,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ defs=list(brick.defs), ok=not any(o[&amp;#x27;output_type&amp;#x27;] == &amp;#x27;error&amp;#x27; for o in outputs))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def retire(self, brick):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Drop the names this brick used to define and no longer does. Returns what went.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ now = set(brick.defs) if brick.runs else set()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ gone = self.owned.get(brick.id, set()) - now&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if gone: self.drop(sorted(gone))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if now: self.owned[brick.id] = now&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ else: self.owned.pop(brick.id, None)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return sorted(gone)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def forget(self, brick_id):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Drop every name one brick defined. What a removed brick leaves behind is nothing.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ gone = self.owned.pop(brick_id, set())&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if gone: self.drop(sorted(gone))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return sorted(gone)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def value(self, expr):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Evaluate one binding expression.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return self.eval_many({&amp;#x27;v&amp;#x27;: expr})[&amp;#x27;v&amp;#x27;]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def bindings(self, brick):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Every port on a brick, resolved. A failed port reports rather than blanking the brick.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return self.eval_many(dict(brick.binds or {}))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def snapshot(self, names=None):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;`{name: resolved}` for the names asked about, or every public one.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return self.eval_many({n: n for n in (names or self.names())})&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def run_all(self, bricks):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Every code brick in dependency order. What a canvas does when it is trusted.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {b.id: self.run(b) for b in order(bricks)}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def react(self, bricks, names, skip=()):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Rerun what depends on `names` and re-resolve every binding it touched. `skip` has just run.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ runs, ports = {}, {}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for b in downstream(bricks, names):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.id in skip: continue&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.runs: runs[b.id] = self.run(b)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.binds: ports[b.id] = self.bindings(b)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return dict(runs=runs, ports=ports)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def close(self): pass&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+class Runtime(Dataflow):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;&amp;quot;&amp;quot;This process&amp;#x27;s own namespace, for the spike and the tests.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ Never the IDE&amp;#x27;s. A cell here holds the web process: `while True` hangs every request and&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ `os._exit()` takes Leela with it. `runtime_for` hands out a `KernelRuntime` wherever a pool&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ exists, and this one only where there is none to hand out.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;&amp;quot;&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def __init__(self, boot=BOOT):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ super().__init__()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ self.ns = {&amp;#x27;__name__&amp;#x27;: &amp;#x27;canvas&amp;#x27;}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if boot: exec(compile(boot, &amp;#x27;&amp;lt;boot&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;exec&amp;#x27;), self.ns)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def exec_cell(self, src, tag=&amp;#x27;cell&amp;#x27;):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out, err, outputs = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO(), []&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ try:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ with redirect_stdout(out), redirect_stderr(err): value = self._exec(src, tag)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if value is not None: outputs.append(result(value))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ except Exception as e: outputs.append(error_out(e))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for text, name in ((out.getvalue(), &amp;#x27;stdout&amp;#x27;), (err.getvalue(), &amp;#x27;stderr&amp;#x27;)):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if text: outputs.insert(0, stream(text, name))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return outputs&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def _exec(self, src, tag):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;quot;Run a block and hand back its trailing expression, the way a notebook cell does.&amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ import ast&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ tree = ast.parse(src)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if tree.body and isinstance(tree.body[-1], ast.Expr):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ last = ast.Expression(tree.body.pop().value)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ exec(compile(tree, f&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;{tag}&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;exec&amp;#x27;), self.ns)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return eval(compile(last, f&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;{tag}&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;eval&amp;#x27;), self.ns)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ exec(compile(tree, f&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;{tag}&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;exec&amp;#x27;), self.ns)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def eval_many(self, exprs):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out = {}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for key, expr in exprs.items():&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ try: out[key] = dict(ok=True, value=jsonable(eval(expr, self.ns)))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ except Exception as e: out[key] = dict(ok=False, error=f&amp;#x27;{type(e).__name__}: {e}&amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return out&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def assign(self, name, value): self.ns[name] = value&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ set = assign&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def drop(self, names):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl
