The &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;ast&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; module reads the dataflow&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+between code bricks off the code itself.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/example.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/export.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/layout.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/ops.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;doc:docs/canvas.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;file:leela/blocks/nb/nb.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Two brick shapes, and the shape follows the content. Code goes in a fence, because a fence is how&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+markdown holds code. A goal or a task goes in a comment wrap, because a reader should see the&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+words and not the markup.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A fence holds what markdown already knows how to show, so a code cell stays a code block. A&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+comment wrap holds what a reader should read as prose, so a goal shows its words and not its&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+markup. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;KINDS&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; is the whole vocabulary, and a document with a word outside it does not parse.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; 12-15&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;FENCED = (&amp;amp;#x27;code&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;ask&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;brick&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;sim&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;data&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;diff&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;snippet&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;pdf&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;video&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+#: Bricks whose body is markdown a plain renderer should still show, written as a comment wrap.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+WRAPPED = (&amp;amp;#x27;reply&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;note&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;quiz&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;goal&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;task&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;source&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;bundle&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+KINDS = (&amp;amp;#x27;text&amp;amp;#x27;,) + FENCED + WRAPPED&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;order&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the graph rather than storing it. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;defs_of&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; asks the code what it defines, and&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;reads_of&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; asks what it reads. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;order&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; joins two bricks when one defines what the other reads.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;order&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the dependency from the code. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;_owners&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; says which brick defines each name, and&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;b.reads&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; says which names a brick needs, so no person draws an edge. On a cycle the visit stops&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+and the document order stands, so a plan with a loop in it still opens.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; order&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def order(bricks):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;Runnable bricks in dependency order, falling back to document order on a cycle.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ live = L(bricks).filter(lambda b: b.runs)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ owner = _owners(live)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ need = {b.id: {owner[n] for n in b.reads if n in owner and owner[n] != b.id} for b in live}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out, seen = [], set()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def visit(b, path):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.id in seen or b.id in path: return&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for dep in need[b.id]: visit(first(x for x in live if x.id == dep), path | {b.id})&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ seen.add(b.id); out.append(b)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for b in live: visit(b, set())&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return L(out)&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;h2 id=&amp;quot;the-basket&amp;quot;&amp;gt;The basket&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;card change&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip done&amp;quot;&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;meta&amp;quot;&amp;gt;Worth: what a question in the document may read&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A question names its own scope, its pins and its budget. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;resolve&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; returns the exact bricks, and each one&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+carries the reason it is there. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;render&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; emits the cells that ramabana&amp;#x27;s &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;compact_notebook_context&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+already knows how to shed.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:ramabana&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;file:leela/blocks/nb/nb.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A notebook sends every brick above the question. A pin sends the two that matter, wherever they&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+sit. An audit belongs to the question at the top of the page and the one at the bottom, and to&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+nothing between.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A question states its own rule, and the rule is four fields. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;scope&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; gathers the first set, &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;pins&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+add what the scope missed, and &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;mutes&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; remove what it caught. An unknown scope becomes &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;page&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+rather than an error, so a typed attribute cannot stop a document from opening.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; Spec&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;@dataclass&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+class Spec:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;A question&amp;amp;#x27;s context rule, written on the brick as attributes and `pin`/`mute` directives.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ scope: str = &amp;amp;#x27;page&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ pins: list = field(default_factory=list)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ mutes: list = field(default_factory=list)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ budget: int | None = None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ goal: bool = True&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def __post_init__(self):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if self.scope not in SCOPES: self.scope = &amp;amp;#x27;page&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;card note&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The budget sheds the least useful brick first, not the oldest, and never a pin or the goal. Each&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;Item&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; carries the &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;why&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; that put it there. A reviewer can therefore see which bricks the budget&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+dropped.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;h2 id=&amp;quot;the-change&amp;quot;&amp;gt;The change&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;card change&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip done&amp;quot;&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;meta&amp;quot;&amp;gt;Worth: all of the review step&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A bundle claims a region, names a goal and owns a list of files. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;coverage&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; compares the claim&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+with the diff. Leela reads &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;state&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; off the document, and no one sets it by hand. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;review&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;, &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;value&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; and &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;pr&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+are three views over the same file.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;README.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/README.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/blocks.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/canvas.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/change.canvas.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/dynamic-documents.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/session.canvas.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/change.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/lit.css&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/lit.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;media/*.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;media/canvas-*.html&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;tools/canvas_spike.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;tools/make_change_page.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;doc:docs/change.canvas.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:mdhtml&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:gheasy&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Leela derives the state of a change. A bundle reaches &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; once every task reaches &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; and&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+every claimed file moved. No one writes that word into the file.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;state&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the word off the document. One blocked task blocks the change, and every task done&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+with every claimed file moved makes it done. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;files_ok&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; treats an absent diff as no evidence, so a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+change nobody has diffed yet does not read as work not started.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/change.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; state&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def state(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ b, # the `Bundle`&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ changed=(), # paths a diff says moved, else no evidence about files&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;Where one change stands, read off the document.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ st = [t.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;status&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;todo&amp;amp;#x27;) for t in b.of(&amp;amp;#x27;task&amp;amp;#x27;)]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ hit = {p for c in b.paths for p in changed if _matches(c, p)}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ unmet = [c for c in b.paths if not any(_matches(c, p) for p in changed)]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ files_ok = not changed or not b.paths or not unmet&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if &amp;amp;#x27;blocked&amp;amp;#x27; in st: return &amp;amp;#x27;blocked&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if st and all(x == &amp;amp;#x27;done&amp;amp;#x27; for x in st) and files_ok: return &amp;amp;#x27;done&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if &amp;amp;#x27;doing&amp;amp;#x27; in st or &amp;amp;#x27;done&amp;amp;#x27; in st or hit: return &amp;amp;#x27;doing&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return &amp;amp;#x27;todo&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The comparison a diff tool cannot make:&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;matched&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; is a claim the diff confirms, &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;unmet&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; is a claim with nothing behind it, and &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;unclaimed&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+is a file that moved with no claim on it. A claim is a glob, so &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/*&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; covers&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+every file the change touched in that folder without naming one of them.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/change.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; coverage&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def coverage(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ doc, # the document&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ changed, # paths a diff says moved&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;What each change claims, what moved, and what nobody claimed.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ changed, rows, claimed = sorted(changed), [], set()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for b in bundles(doc):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ hit = {p for c in b.paths for p in changed if _matches(c, p)}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ claimed |= hit&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ rows.append({&amp;amp;#x27;id&amp;amp;#x27;: b.id, &amp;amp;#x27;title&amp;amp;#x27;: b.title, &amp;amp;#x27;goal&amp;amp;#x27;: b.goal.id if b.goal else &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;paths&amp;amp;#x27;: b.paths, &amp;amp;#x27;matched&amp;amp;#x27;: sorted(hit),&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;unmet&amp;amp;#x27;: [c for c in b.paths if not any(_matches(c, p) for p in changed)],&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;tasks_open&amp;amp;#x27;: [t.id for t in b.of(&amp;amp;#x27;task&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if t.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;status&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;todo&amp;amp;#x27;) not in (&amp;amp;#x27;done&amp;amp;#x27;,)]})&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;amp;#x27;bundles&amp;amp;#x27;: rows, &amp;amp;#x27;unclaimed&amp;amp;#x27;: [p for p in changed if p not in claimed]}&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;h2 id=&amp;quot;the-page&amp;quot;&amp;gt;The page&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Leela now assembles this page. The tool that used to do it picks a file and prints a line.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;page&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; fills the slots, counts the files and writes the HTML in one call. It returns the file list&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+and the unclaimed list, so a caller sees the finding without opening the page.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/app.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; page&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def page(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ doc, # the document, its `diff` bricks still empty&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ dest, # where to write the page&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ base=&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;, # what the file list is diffed against&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;The literate page: fill the diff a document asks for, then render it.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ place_diff(doc, lambda paths, left, right: _diff(doc, left or base, paths, right))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ changed = _changed(doc, base)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ root = _root(doc)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ sub = (f&amp;amp;#x27;Generated by canvas.lit from {Path(doc.path).name}. Every snippet is read from the &amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;file it names.&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out = lit(doc, dest, changed=changed, root=root, subtitle=sub)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return {&amp;amp;#x27;path&amp;amp;#x27;: str(out), &amp;amp;#x27;changed&amp;amp;#x27;: changed,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;unclaimed&amp;amp;#x27;: coverage(doc, changed)[&amp;amp;#x27;unclaimed&amp;amp;#x27;],&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;#x27;diffs&amp;amp;#x27;: [b.id for b in doc.of(&amp;amp;#x27;diff&amp;amp;#x27;)]}&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; brick with no body is a slot. It says which paths it wants and which two commits to&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+compare. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;place_diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; calls git once per slot and replaces the slot with one brick a file. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;place_diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; marks a brick&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+no bundle claims, and the page shows a warning on it.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;place_diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the request off the brick. A &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; brick with a body is content, and is left&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+alone, so a pasted diff is never overwritten. Each slot becomes one brick a file, and a file no&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+bundle claims gets &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;claimed=no&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;, which the page shows as a warning.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/change.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; place_diff&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def place_diff(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ doc, # the document, with `diff` bricks that carry no body&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ get, # `get(paths, left, right) -&amp;amp;gt; str`: the diff text those attributes ask for&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;Fill every empty `diff` brick from the diff it asks for. One brick per file.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for slot in doc.of(&amp;amp;#x27;diff&amp;amp;#x27;).filter(lambda b: not b.body.strip()):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ at = doc.index(slot.id)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if at is None: continue&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ doc.bricks.pop(at)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ raw = get(_list(slot.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;paths&amp;amp;#x27;)), slot.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;left&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;),&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ slot.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;right&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ made = []&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for n, (path, text) in enumerate(hunks(raw).items()):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ add, rm = diff_stat(text)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ made.append(Brick(&amp;amp;#x27;diff&amp;amp;#x27;, text, id=f&amp;amp;#x27;{slot.id}-{Path(path).name}&amp;amp;#x27;,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ attrs={&amp;amp;#x27;path&amp;amp;#x27;: path, &amp;amp;#x27;added&amp;amp;#x27;: str(add), &amp;amp;#x27;removed&amp;amp;#x27;: str(rm)}))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ doc.bricks.insert(at + n, made[-1])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ loose = set(coverage(doc, [b.attrs[&amp;amp;#x27;path&amp;amp;#x27;] for b in made])[&amp;amp;#x27;unclaimed&amp;amp;#x27;])&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for b in made:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.attrs[&amp;amp;#x27;path&amp;amp;#x27;] in loose: b.attrs[&amp;amp;#x27;claimed&amp;amp;#x27;] = &amp;amp;#x27;no&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return doc._regions()&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The page folds anything longer than a phone screen. A diff body scrolls sideways inside its own&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+box, and a long line therefore never widens the page.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The renderer folds a diff longer than a phone screen, and the summary still names the file and the&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+counts. It drops the git headers a reader does not need. It writes no script, so the fold is&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;details&amp;amp;gt;&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; and the page works with JavaScript turned off.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/lit.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; _diff&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def _diff(b):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ rows = [l for l in b.body.split(&amp;amp;#x27;\n&amp;amp;#x27;) if not l.startswith(_SKIP)]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ body = &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;.join(&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ f&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;lt;span class=&amp;amp;quot;dl {&amp;amp;quot;a&amp;amp;quot; if l[:1] == &amp;amp;quot;+&amp;amp;quot; else &amp;amp;quot;r&amp;amp;quot; if l[:1] == &amp;amp;quot;-&amp;amp;quot; else &amp;amp;quot;h&amp;amp;quot; if l[:2] == &amp;amp;quot;@@&amp;amp;quot; else &amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;quot;}&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ f&amp;amp;#x27;{escape(l) or &amp;amp;quot; &amp;amp;quot;}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27; for l in rows)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ add, rm = diff_stat(b.body)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ chips = (f&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;lt;span class=&amp;amp;quot;chip add&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;+{add}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;span class=&amp;amp;quot;chip rm&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;-{rm}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ + (&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;lt;span class=&amp;amp;quot;chip warn&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;no bundle claims this&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;claimed&amp;amp;#x27;) == &amp;amp;#x27;no&amp;amp;#x27; else &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;))&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ path = b.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;path&amp;amp;#x27;, &amp;amp;#x27;diff&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if len(rows) &amp;amp;gt; FOLD_LINES: # the summary already names the file and the counts&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ warn = &amp;amp;#x27; - no bundle claims this&amp;amp;#x27; if b.attrs.get(&amp;amp;#x27;claimed&amp;amp;#x27;) == &amp;amp;#x27;no&amp;amp;#x27; else &amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return _fold(f&amp;amp;#x27;{path} +{add} -{rm}{warn}&amp;amp;#x27;, f&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;lt;div class=&amp;amp;quot;diff&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;div class=&amp;amp;quot;body&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;{body}&amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return (f&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;lt;figure&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;div class=&amp;amp;quot;diff&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;div class=&amp;amp;quot;hd&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;span class=&amp;amp;quot;p&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;{escape(path)}&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ f&amp;amp;#x27;{chips}&amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;div class=&amp;amp;quot;body&amp;amp;quot;&amp;amp;gt;{body}&amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/figure&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;#x27;)&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;h2 id=&amp;quot;the-prompts&amp;quot;&amp;gt;The prompts&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;card change&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip done&amp;quot;&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;meta&amp;quot;&amp;gt;Worth: the words on this page&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Leela drafts from two files, and no third. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;explain.md&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; holds the task and &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;ste.md&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; holds the English.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;rule_text&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the writing rules from ramabana&amp;#x27;s &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;write_docs&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; pyskill at the time of the call,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+so this repository keeps no copy of them.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/explain.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/explain.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/ste.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:ramabana&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:shalya&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The voiceless GDS register, the banned words, no hedging, no restatement. Read through&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;shalya.skills.discover()&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;, never copied here. When the skill is missing, &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;rule_text&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; raises&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+rather than falling back to a stale copy.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;rule_text&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reads the writing rules from where ramabana installed them. It keeps no copy, so a&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+change to &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;write_docs&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; reaches this prompt with no edit here. A missing skill raises rather than&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+falling back, because a silent fallback would draft prose against stale rules.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/explain.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; rule_text&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;def rule_text(names=RULES):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;The named skills, read from where they are installed. This package holds no copy of them.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ try: from shalya.skills import discover, find&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ except ImportError as e:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ raise LookupError(&amp;amp;#x27;shalya is not installed, so the skills cannot be read; pass `rules=`&amp;amp;#x27;) from e&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ found = discover()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out = []&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ for n in names:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ s = find(found, n)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if s is None: raise LookupError(f&amp;amp;#x27;skill {n!r} is not installed; pass `rules=` instead&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ out.append(f&amp;amp;#x27;## {s.name}\n\n{s.text()}&amp;amp;#x27;)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return &amp;amp;#x27;\n\n&amp;amp;#x27;.join(out)&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A brick the model drafted carries &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;wrote=ai&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; in the file. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;git diff&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; therefore shows the drafting,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+and a reviewer can read those bricks first. A person wrote every snippet on this page, and no&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+brick here carries the mark.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;h2 id=&amp;quot;the-library&amp;quot;&amp;gt;The library&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;card change&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip done&amp;quot;&amp;gt;done&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;meta&amp;quot;&amp;gt;Worth: the palette, with no second process&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The palette used to be an HTTP call to a second server. It is now an entry-point group. A library&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+answers four questions: its manifest, one brick, that brick&amp;#x27;s wiring, and its own routes. An HTTP&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+host answers the same four, and it stays for a library nobody installed.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;docs/bricks.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;extensions/bricks/*&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/bricks.py&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;tests/fixtures/*&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;chips&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;pkg:leela-bricks&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;span class=&amp;quot;chip&amp;quot;&amp;gt;doc:docs/bricks.md&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;The four questions are the whole contract. A library that answers them needs to know nothing about&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+Leela, and Leela needs to know nothing about the library.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;A library answers four questions and knows nothing about Leela. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;manifest&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; lists its components,&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;code&amp;gt;find&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; returns one, &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;wire&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; returns the code that fills its ports, and &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;mount&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; puts its own routes&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+on the app it is handed. &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;manifest&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; is read in process, so the palette needs no second server.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+&amp;lt;figure&amp;gt;&amp;lt;figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;b&amp;gt;leela/blocks/canvas/bricks.py&amp;lt;/b&amp;gt; &amp;amp;middot; Library&amp;lt;/figcaption&amp;gt;&amp;lt;details&amp;gt;&amp;lt;summary&amp;gt;Library (35 lines)&amp;lt;/summary&amp;gt;&amp;lt;div class=&amp;quot;in&amp;quot;&amp;gt;&amp;lt;pre&amp;gt;&amp;lt;code class=&amp;quot;lang-python&amp;quot;&amp;gt;@dataclass&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+class Library:&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;One brick library, imported. Its manifest is read in process, never fetched.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ name: str&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ module: object&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def _r(self): return _reg(self.module)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def manifest(self):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ r = self._r()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return r.manifest() if r else {&amp;amp;#x27;bricks&amp;amp;#x27;: [], &amp;amp;#x27;groups&amp;amp;#x27;: {}}&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def find(self, name):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ r = self._r()&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ b = r.find(name) if r else None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ return b.dict() if hasattr(b, &amp;amp;#x27;dict&amp;amp;#x27;) else b&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ def wire(self, name, base=&amp;amp;#x27;&amp;amp;#x27;):&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ &amp;amp;quot;What fills this brick&amp;amp;#x27;s ports: the snippet it ships, and the call that reads it remotely.&amp;amp;quot;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ b = self.find(name)&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+ if b is None: return None&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span This is why &amp;lt;code&amp;gt;extensions/bricks&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt; extracted with no&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;dl a&quot;&gt;+code change. is not one kind of work. You frame the</span><span class="dl a">+measure. You collect what people already know. You pull an extract apart. You prototype one rule.</span><span class="dl a">+You write the recommendation.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;Today each of those lives in a different tool. The plan is in a tracker. The numbers are in a</span><span class="dl a">+notebook. The research is in browser tabs. The recommendation is in a deck. Nothing crosses</span><span class="dl a">+between them except a person who remembers all four.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;One file now holds every one of the four. It is a markdown file. Prose stays prose, and each</span><span class="dl a">+other part is a brick.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;div class=&quot;card goal&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;stmt&quot;&gt;Give Leela one document that holds a goal, its plan, its research, its code and its questions.&lt;/div&gt;&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;measure&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;tools you open to review one change against its goal&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;dt&gt;baseline&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;4: tracker, notebook, diff, deck&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;dt&gt;target&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;1 page&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;dt&gt;by&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;2026-10-31&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;card change&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;chips&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip done&quot;&gt;done&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;meta&quot;&gt;Worth: all of the review step; none of the run step, which the canvas branch owns&lt;/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;Adds &lt;code&gt;leela/blocks/canvas&lt;/code&gt;, a block that reads and writes the canvas document. A question in the</span><span class="dl a">+document names what the model may read. A boundary on the canvas is one change. A change names the</span><span class="dl a">+goal that it serves.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;div class=&quot;chips&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;docs/*.md&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;leela/blocks/__init__.py&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/*&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;media/*&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;tests/routes.txt&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;tests/test_canvas_doc.py&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;tools/make_change_page.py&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;chips&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;doc:docs/dynamic-documents.md&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;file:leela/blocks/nb/nb.py&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;chip&quot;&gt;pkg:mdhtml&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;ul class=&quot;tasks&quot;&gt;&lt;li class=&quot;done&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;box&quot;&gt;[x]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;Read the document format from the canvas branch.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;who&quot;&gt;me&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class=&quot;done&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;box&quot;&gt;[x]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;Build the context basket, the change bundle, the review and the value view.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;who&quot;&gt;me&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class=&quot;done&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;box&quot;&gt;[x]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;Write this page from the document, with the code it explains.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;who&quot;&gt;me&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class=&quot;done&quot;&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;box&quot;&gt;[x]&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;Move the modules into `leela/blocks/canvas/`.&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;who&quot;&gt;me&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;h2 id=&quot;words&quot;&gt;Words&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Read this table first. Every later section uses these words and no others.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;table&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;thead&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;word&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;means&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;/thead&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tbody&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;brick&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;one part of the document. A fence or a comment wrap. A code cell, a question, a goal, a task, a clipping.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;prose&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;ordinary markdown between bricks. It needs no markup of its own.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;region&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the bricks under one heading. The headings make the regions, so nobody writes one.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;basket&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the exact list of bricks that one question sends to the model.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;scope&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;how a question gathers its first set of bricks. &lt;code&gt;page&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;region&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;upstream&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;doc&lt;/code&gt; or &lt;code&gt;none&lt;/code&gt;.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;pin&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;a brick a question always reads, whatever the scope says. A &lt;code&gt;mute&lt;/code&gt; is the opposite.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;budget&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;how many characters a question may send. The goal and the pins survive it.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;upstream&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the bricks a brick reads from. Read off the code, never drawn by hand.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;bundle&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;one unit of change. It claims a region, names a goal, and owns a list of files.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;snippet&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;a brick that cites code out of a file. It holds no copy of that code.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;&lt;strong&gt;canvas&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;the second view of the document. The same bricks, with coordinates.&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;/tbody&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;/table&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The block is &lt;code&gt;canvas&lt;/code&gt; and the file is &lt;code&gt;*.canvas.md&lt;/code&gt;. An earlier draft of this work was a separate</span><span class="dl a">+package called &lt;code&gt;pata&lt;/code&gt;, from the Sanskrit &lt;code&gt;pata&lt;/code&gt;, the cloth a painter paints a scroll on. That</span><span class="dl a">+name is gone, and &lt;code&gt;canvas&lt;/code&gt; is the only name now.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;h2 id=&quot;why-it-helps&quot;&gt;Why it helps&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;A notebook picks context by position: every cell above the question. That is right for a script,</span><span class="dl a">+where the cells above are the steps you took. A plan holds four lines of work at once. Position therefore hands the recommendation question</span><span class="dl a">+three failed attempts at a groupby. The alternative is to turn it off and paste the same</span><span class="dl a">+paragraphs again.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;An audit shows the limit. It belongs to the question near the top of the document and to the risk</span><span class="dl a">+question near the bottom, and to nothing between them. Where a brick sits says nothing about which</span><span class="dl a">+questions it answers.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A document that can say it gives three things.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A question shows its basket before it runs: each brick, why it is there, and what it costs. Mute</span><span class="dl a">+one and the count drops.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A boundary on the canvas is a change you can review. It names the goal, owns the files, and holds</span><span class="dl a">+the tasks, the prose and the code together. One page therefore answers whether the change does</span><span class="dl a">+what the goal said.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A goal shows what serves it, and shows a goal that nothing serves. The second is the worse finding,</span><span class="dl a">+because it looks like a goal that is going well.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-file&quot;&gt;The file&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;A &lt;code&gt;pata&lt;/code&gt; document is one markdown file. Prose stays prose. Each other part is a brick. A brick is</span><span class="dl a">+a fence or a comment wrap.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The reader reads the file line by line. It does not use one pattern on the whole file. This is</span><span class="dl a">+necessary. A document about canvases shows fences as examples. A fence inside a longer fence is an</span><span class="dl a">+example. It is not a brick.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The &lt;code&gt;TICKS&lt;/code&gt; branch does the work. It sees a plain fence, puts the fence into the prose, and skips</span><span class="dl a">+to the end of it. Nothing inside that fence becomes a brick. This page is such a document, and it</span><span class="dl a">+reads correctly.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; _scan&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;_scan (36 lines)&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;in&quot;&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def _scan(text):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;`(kind, attrline, body)` per brick. A fence inside a longer fence is an example of one, not one.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ lines, i, prose, out = text.split(&amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;), 0, [], []</span><span class="dl a">+ def flush():</span><span class="dl a">+ for part in _prose_parts(&amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(prose)): out.append((&amp;#x27;text&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;, part))</span><span class="dl a">+ prose.clear()</span><span class="dl a">+ def upto(j, shut, keep):</span><span class="dl a">+ body = []</span><span class="dl a">+ while j &amp;lt; len(lines) and not shut(lines[j]): body.append(lines[j]); j += 1</span><span class="dl a">+ if keep and j &amp;lt; len(lines): body.append(lines[j])</span><span class="dl a">+ return j, body</span><span class="dl a">+ while i &amp;lt; len(lines):</span><span class="dl a">+ line = lines[i]</span><span class="dl a">+ if (m := FENCE.match(line)):</span><span class="dl a">+ flush()</span><span class="dl a">+ end = _shut(m[1])</span><span class="dl a">+ i, body = upto(i + 1, lambda l: end.match(l), False)</span><span class="dl a">+ out.append((m[2], m[3], &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(body) + (&amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27; if body else &amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;)))</span><span class="dl a">+ elif (m := TICKS.match(line)):</span><span class="dl a">+ end = _shut(m[1])</span><span class="dl a">+ prose.append(line)</span><span class="dl a">+ i, body = upto(i + 1, lambda l: end.match(l), True)</span><span class="dl a">+ prose.extend(body)</span><span class="dl a">+ elif (m := WRAP.match(line)):</span><span class="dl a">+ flush()</span><span class="dl a">+ attr = [line[m.end():]]</span><span class="dl a">+ while not SHUT_TAG.search(attr[-1]) and i + 1 &amp;lt; len(lines): # a long attribute list wraps</span><span class="dl a">+ i += 1</span><span class="dl a">+ attr.append(lines[i])</span><span class="dl a">+ i, body = upto(i + 1, lambda l: l.strip() == SHUT, False)</span><span class="dl a">+ out.append((m[1], SHUT_TAG.sub(&amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;, &amp;#x27; &amp;#x27;.join(attr)), &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(body) + (&amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27; if body else &amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;)))</span><span class="dl a">+ else:</span><span class="dl a">+ prose.append(line); i += 1; continue</span><span class="dl a">+ i += 1</span><span class="dl a">+ flush()</span><span class="dl a">+ return out&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;Headings are the regions of the document. Nobody writes a region. The reader gives each brick the</span><span class="dl a">+heading above it.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; Doc._regions&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-basket&quot;&gt;The basket&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;Each question carries a rule. The rule says what the question may read. &lt;code&gt;resolve&lt;/code&gt; turns the rule</span><span class="dl a">+into the exact list that the turn will send.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The list is the point. &lt;code&gt;resolve&lt;/code&gt; gives back items, not one string. The same list draws the panel</span><span class="dl a">+and builds the prompt. What a person sees is what the model gets.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;Four rules, in order. The goal goes in first. Then each pin. A pin that no longer exists becomes a</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;code&gt;missing&lt;/code&gt; item. It is visible. A silent drop is worse, because the person still believes the pin is</span><span class="dl a">+there.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; resolve&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;details&gt;&lt;summary&gt;resolve (29 lines)&lt;/summary&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;in&quot;&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def resolve(</span><span class="dl a">+ doc, # the document</span><span class="dl a">+ bid, # which brick asks</span><span class="dl a">+ spec=None, # the rule, else the one the brick carries</span><span class="dl a">+ values=None, # `{brick id: output text}` from the live namespace</span><span class="dl a">+ lookup=None, # `lookup(ref)` for a pin the document does not own</span><span class="dl a">+ extra=(), # items the host adds, such as live variables</span><span class="dl a">+):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;The exact basket for question `bid`, in the order the model reads it.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ b = doc.by_id(bid)</span><span class="dl a">+ if b is None: raise KeyError(bid)</span><span class="dl a">+ spec = spec or spec_of(b)</span><span class="dl a">+ mutes, items, seen = set(spec.mutes), [], {b.id}</span><span class="dl a">+ def take(x, why, pinned=False):</span><span class="dl a">+ if x.id in seen or x.id in mutes: return</span><span class="dl a">+ if not (t := body_text(x, values, doc)).strip(): return</span><span class="dl a">+ seen.add(x.id)</span><span class="dl a">+ items.append(Item(ref=x.id, kind=x.kind, label=_label(x), text=t, why=why,</span><span class="dl a">+ region=x.region, mode=x.mode, pinned=pinned or x.mode == &amp;#x27;keep&amp;#x27;))</span><span class="dl a">+ if spec.goal and (g := doc.goal_for(bid)) is not None and g.id not in mutes: take(g, &amp;#x27;goal&amp;#x27;, True)</span><span class="dl a">+ for r in spec.pins:</span><span class="dl a">+ if r in mutes: continue</span><span class="dl a">+ if _is_ref(r): items.append(_ref_item(r, lookup))</span><span class="dl a">+ elif (x := doc.by_id(r)) is not None: take(x, &amp;#x27;pin&amp;#x27;, True)</span><span class="dl a">+ else: items.append(Item(ref=r, kind=&amp;#x27;missing&amp;#x27;, label=r, text=&amp;#x27;&amp;#x27;, why=&amp;#x27;pin&amp;#x27;, pinned=True,</span><span class="dl a">+ clipped=True))</span><span class="dl a">+ for x in members(doc, b, spec.scope): take(x, spec.scope)</span><span class="dl a">+ items += list(extra)</span><span class="dl a">+ return _fit(items, spec.budget)&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/details&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;A scope gives the first set of bricks. &lt;code&gt;page&lt;/code&gt; is the notebook rule. &lt;code&gt;region&lt;/code&gt; is the section that</span><span class="dl a">+you work in. &lt;code&gt;upstream&lt;/code&gt; is what the question reads from.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; members&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def members(doc, b, scope):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;The bricks a scope offers, before pins, mutes and the budget.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ if scope == &amp;#x27;none&amp;#x27;: return L()</span><span class="dl a">+ at = doc.index(b.id)</span><span class="dl a">+ if at is None: at = len(doc)</span><span class="dl a">+ if scope == &amp;#x27;page&amp;#x27;: return L(doc.bricks[:at])</span><span class="dl a">+ if scope == &amp;#x27;doc&amp;#x27;: return L(x for x in doc.bricks if x.id != b.id)</span><span class="dl a">+ if scope == &amp;#x27;region&amp;#x27;: return L(x for x in doc.in_region(b.region) if x.id != b.id)</span><span class="dl a">+ return upstream(doc.bricks, b.id)&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;The budget cuts the list. Two rules must hold. The goal and the pins stay. A pin that is larger</span><span class="dl a">+than the whole budget gets shorter; it does not go.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The last block is the one that matters. If every item that is left is pinned, the code cuts each</span><span class="dl a">+item to a share of the budget and marks it. It never drops a pin.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; _fit&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def _fit(items, budget):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;Trim to `budget`. Pins and `keep` never drop; `discard` goes first, then the oldest `auto`.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ if not budget: return items</span><span class="dl a">+ total = sum(i.chars + WRAP for i in items)</span><span class="dl a">+ if total &amp;lt;= budget: return items</span><span class="dl a">+ order = sorted((i for i, it in enumerate(items) if not it.pinned),</span><span class="dl a">+ key=lambda i: (items[i].mode != &amp;#x27;discard&amp;#x27;, i))</span><span class="dl a">+ drop, n = set(), 0</span><span class="dl a">+ while total &amp;gt; budget and n &amp;lt; len(order):</span><span class="dl a">+ total -= items[order[n]].chars + WRAP</span><span class="dl a">+ drop.add(order[n])</span><span class="dl a">+ n += 1</span><span class="dl a">+ kept = [it for i, it in enumerate(items) if i not in drop]</span><span class="dl a">+ if sum(i.chars + WRAP for i in kept) &amp;gt; budget and kept:</span><span class="dl a">+ share = max(200, budget // max(1, len(kept)) - WRAP)</span><span class="dl a">+ kept = [replace(it, text=it.text[:share] + &amp;#x27;\n…&amp;#x27;, clipped=True) if it.chars &amp;gt; share else it</span><span class="dl a">+ for it in kept]</span><span class="dl a">+ return kept&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;The markup is &lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;cell&amp;gt;&lt;/code&gt; with a &lt;code&gt;compact&lt;/code&gt; attribute. This is Leela&#x27;s own notebook shape, and the</span><span class="dl a">+choice is deliberate. Ramabana drops &lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;cell&amp;gt;&lt;/code&gt; elements when a prompt is too large for the window.</span><span class="dl a">+A document that wrote &lt;code&gt;&amp;lt;block&amp;gt;&lt;/code&gt; would lose that net.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/context.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; render&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def render(items, doc=None):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;The basket as `&amp;lt;cell&amp;gt;` markup, which is Leela’s own notebook context shape.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ out = []</span><span class="dl a">+ for it in items:</span><span class="dl a">+ if not it.text.strip(): continue</span><span class="dl a">+ attr = (f&amp;#x27;id=&amp;quot;{it.ref}&amp;quot; type=&amp;quot;{it.kind}&amp;quot; compact=&amp;quot;{&amp;quot;keep&amp;quot; if it.pinned else &amp;quot;auto&amp;quot;}&amp;quot; &amp;#x27;</span><span class="dl a">+ f&amp;#x27;why=&amp;quot;{it.why}&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;)</span><span class="dl a">+ if it.region: attr += f&amp;#x27; region=&amp;quot;{it.region}&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;</span><span class="dl a">+ if it.clipped: attr += &amp;#x27; clipped=&amp;quot;true&amp;quot;&amp;#x27;</span><span class="dl a">+ out.append(f&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;cell {attr}&amp;gt;\n{it.text}\n&amp;lt;/cell&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;)</span><span class="dl a">+ if doc is not None and (links := _links(doc, {i.ref for i in items if i.text.strip()})):</span><span class="dl a">+ out.append(&amp;#x27;&amp;lt;links&amp;gt;\n&amp;#x27; + &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(links) + &amp;#x27;\n&amp;lt;/links&amp;gt;&amp;#x27;)</span><span class="dl a">+ return &amp;#x27;\n&amp;#x27;.join(out)&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-wiring&quot;&gt;The wiring&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;upstream&lt;/code&gt; reads the code. It does not read a diagram. A name belongs to the brick that binds it.</span><span class="dl a">+A diagram beside the code goes wrong; the code does not.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;defs_of&lt;/code&gt; finds each name that a cell binds at the top level of its code. It looks inside &lt;code&gt;if&lt;/code&gt;,</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;code&gt;for&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;try&lt;/code&gt; and &lt;code&gt;with&lt;/code&gt;. It does not look inside a &lt;code&gt;def&lt;/code&gt;, because a name in a function belongs to</span><span class="dl a">+the function.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; defs_of&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def defs_of(source):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;Names a code brick binds at module level, however it binds them.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ t = _walk(source)</span><span class="dl a">+ if t is None: return L()</span><span class="dl a">+ out = L()</span><span class="dl a">+ for n in _module_body(t):</span><span class="dl a">+ if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)): out.append(n.name)</span><span class="dl a">+ elif isinstance(n, ast.Assign): out += L(n.targets).map(_targets).concat()</span><span class="dl a">+ elif isinstance(n, (ast.AnnAssign, ast.AugAssign)): out += _targets(n.target)</span><span class="dl a">+ elif isinstance(n, (ast.For, ast.AsyncFor)): out += _targets(n.target)</span><span class="dl a">+ elif isinstance(n, (ast.With, ast.AsyncWith)):</span><span class="dl a">+ out += L(n.items).map(lambda i: _targets(i.optional_vars)).concat()</span><span class="dl a">+ elif isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):</span><span class="dl a">+ out += L(n.names).map(lambda a: (a.asname or a.name).split(&amp;#x27;.&amp;#x27;)[0])</span><span class="dl a">+ for n in ast.walk(t):</span><span class="dl a">+ if isinstance(n, ast.NamedExpr): out += _targets(n.target)</span><span class="dl a">+ return out.unique()&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;Three additions reach where the code cannot see.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A question anchors on the brick above it. &quot;Fix that&quot; means that brick and all that it reads.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A name in backticks is a name that the question reads. Write &lt;code&gt;`triage`&lt;/code&gt; and the brick that</span><span class="dl a">+defines &lt;code&gt;triage&lt;/code&gt; goes in.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;supports=&lt;/code&gt;, &lt;code&gt;refutes=&lt;/code&gt; and &lt;code&gt;blocks=&lt;/code&gt; state a relation between two bricks. No code states these.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/doc.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; upstream&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt;def upstream(bricks, bid, depth=12):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;Every brick `bid` reads from, transitively, in document order.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ bricks = L(bricks)</span><span class="dl a">+ owner, seen = _owners(bricks), set()</span><span class="dl a">+ want = {bid} | ({a} if (a := anchor_of(bricks, bid)) else set())</span><span class="dl a">+ seen |= want - {bid}</span><span class="dl a">+ for _ in range(depth):</span><span class="dl a">+ nxt = set()</span><span class="dl a">+ for b in bricks.filter(lambda b: b.id in want):</span><span class="dl a">+ nxt |= {owner[n] for n in b.reads if n in owner}</span><span class="dl a">+ for ids in b.links.values(): nxt |= set(ids)</span><span class="dl a">+ nxt -= seen | {bid}</span><span class="dl a">+ if not nxt: break</span><span class="dl a">+ seen |= nxt</span><span class="dl a">+ want = nxt</span><span class="dl a">+ seen |= {b.id for b in bricks if bid in {i for ids in b.links.values() for i in ids}}</span><span class="dl a">+ return bricks.filter(lambda b: b.id in seen - {bid})&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;h2 id=&quot;the-change&quot;&gt;The change&lt;/h2&gt;&lt;p&gt;A region groups bricks to read. A &lt;code&gt;bundle&lt;/code&gt; brick claims its region as one change. The boundary on</span><span class="dl a">+the canvas is then the thing that a reviewer opens.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;The files come from the code first. A code brick with &lt;code&gt;#|export&lt;/code&gt; writes a module. Leela therefore knows the module</span><span class="dl a">+path. &lt;code&gt;paths=&lt;/code&gt; adds only what the bricks do not write.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;A list that a person keeps by hand goes out of date. A claim that is out of date is worse than no</span><span class="dl a">+claim, because a reviewer trusts it.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;figure&gt;&lt;figcaption&gt;&lt;b&gt;leela/blocks/canvas/change.py&lt;/b&gt; &amp;middot; Bundle.paths&lt;/figcaption&gt;&lt;pre&gt;&lt;code class=&quot;lang-python&quot;&gt; @property</span><span class="dl a">+ def paths(self):</span><span class="dl a">+ &amp;quot;Files this change owns: what its code exports, then what `paths=` declares.&amp;quot;</span><span class="dl a">+ mine = {b.id for b in self.of(&amp;#x27;code&amp;#x27;)}</span><span class="dl a">+ one = Canvas(bricks=[b for b in self.doc.bricks if b.id in mine], meta=self.doc.meta)</span><span class="dl a">+ return sorted(set(modules(one)) | set(_list(self.brick.attrs.get(&amp;#x27;paths&amp;#x27;))))&lt;/code&gt;&lt;/pre&gt;&lt;/figure&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;coverage&lt;/code&gt; holds the claim against the diff. It reports three things. Two of them are new.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;&lt;code&gt;matched&lt;/code&gt; is a file that the bundle claims and the diff changed. &lt;code&gt;unmet&lt;/code&gt; is a file that the bundle</span><span class="dl a">+claims and the diff did not change. &lt;code&gt;unclaimed&lt;/code&gt; is a file that the diff changed and no bundle</span><span class="dl a">+explains.&lt;/p&gt;</span><span class="dl a">+&lt;p&gt;No diff tool can find &lt;code&gt;unclaimed&lt;/code&gt;.
